description: Per-row mapping from animation state keys to AnimMontage primary-asset names, used to install montages on character anim instances and to build capture maps.

Id.simple: Animation group row key (character or specialized group such as facial parts).
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name (exported as ID). CharacterAnimationSet.Id_CharacterAnimation entries and several capture/pose rows use this name to find the row in CharacterAnimationDataTables. The export contains 1125 groups; targets include base character rows and suffixed groups such as CP_010_FACIAL and CP_010_ATTACKA.

Key.simple: Parallel list of animation state names that a montage gets bound to.
Key.technical: TArray<FName>, 35 entries in every exported row, with trailing None slots. Consumers iterate Key.Num() and pair Key[Index] with FileName[Index]; None keys are skipped. BattleBase passes the key to UGameCharacterAnimInstance::SetAnimationAsset(Key, Montage, bDuplicate), with Idle/Fall_01 flagged as duplicates; capture actors build a TMap<Key, FileName>, optionally filtered to idle/enter keys. No separate length check against FileName is performed, so arrays must be parallel.

FileName.simple: Parallel list of AnimMontage primary-asset names paired with Key.
FileName.technical: TArray<FName> serialized as Filename in the export. BattleAsset collectors append non-None FileName entries to the AnimMontage preload name list; battle/sequencer code looks up StudioAnimMontageLoaders by FileName, resolves the loaded UAnimMontage and installs it at the matching Key. Capture code maps Key -> FileName and plays the montage at FileName[0] for situation-overview poses. None entries are skipped where the loop checks them, but FileName[0] is indexed directly in the pose playback path.

notes: Key and FileName are positional pairs; all 1125 exported rows have 35 entries in each array, with trailing None placeholders. Consumers index both arrays by the same loop index without a bounds comparison beyond Key.Num().
No localization variants of this table were exported. The available Content is partial and the export does not prove every retail animation group.
Evidence is reconstructed C++; montage loaders are primary-asset loaders keyed by FileName, not direct object paths stored in the table.
The export label is Filename while the USTRUCT property and source consumers use FileName.

usages.detail: Finds an animation group and appends all FileName entries to the battle asset preload list.
Resolves each character's animation set, then uses BattleAssets_AnimMontages_12BC030 to collect montage names for primary-asset loading.
Installs each loaded montage on the spawned character's anim instance at the matching Key, flagging duplicate Idle/Fall_01 bindings.
Installs set-provided montages into studio characters spawned for sequencer scenes.
Builds a Key -> FileName map for captures, filtered to idle/enter keys for non-situation-overview captures.
Plays FileName[0] of the situation-overview pose's animation row as a montage.
